v1.1.1 Update
- Enter formulas such as {value} * 5 in Actor value connections in either editor. Preview the result and see expression errors without changing the Actor sheet.
- Imported parts keep their frames, decorations, meter fills, and internal layout on pages using other themes, including grouped and repeated parts. This fixes health bars disappearing on Ironpass Expedition pages.
- Imported text keeps its intended wrapping. Older parts with incomplete font settings use their source theme's font defaults.
- The Use role value checkbox now sits beside its label in both editors.

announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.1.1
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.1.1

  • Enter formulas such as {value} * 5 in Actor value connections in either editor. Preview the result and see expression errors without changing the Actor sheet.
  • Imported parts keep their frames, decorations, meter fills, and internal layout on pages using other themes, including grouped and repeated parts. This fixes health bars disappearing on Ironpass Expedition pages.
  • Imported text keeps its intended wrapping. Older parts with incomplete font settings use their source theme's font defaults.
  • The Use role value checkbox now sits beside its label in both editors.
